title: Altus Research: Warehouse Robotics Share Report 2025 (by units)
text: Methodology: share is computed on 2025 units shipped to warehouse customers, 36 vendors surveyed, demo units excluded. By 2025 units shipped, Kestrel Robotics led the warehouse AMR market with 29% share, ahead of Voltrix Dynamics at 26%. Kestrel's lower-priced K-series drives its unit lead.

facts.statement: By 2025 units shipped, Kestrel Robotics led the warehouse AMR market with 29% share, ahead of Voltrix Dynamics at 26%.
